summary: A destructive alert dialog whose async confirm handler waits 1.5 seconds before an Item removed note appears.
use: Confirming a delete that calls the server, where the dialog waits for the request before closing.
spec: `onconfirm={removeItem}` is an async function that awaits `wait(1500)` then sets `done = true`
Trigger is `<Button variant="destructive"` labelled Remove item (1.5s)
Result note uses `aria-live="polite"` and shows when `{#if done}`
